title: True Ones Are Among Us and Must Be Followed
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah.
Yaa Rabbee zid habeebaka Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen sharafan `ala sharafahu 'Lladhee `ataytah.
zidhu sharafan wa karaman wa 'l-amaan wa nooran wa suroorun. Yaa Mawlayi. Thumma 's-salaat wa 'ssalaam `ala Jami`ee al-Anbiyaa wa 'l-mursaleen wa `ala man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan min `ibaadika asSaaliheen. Yaa Rabbee akrimna bi itiba`ihim w'aja`lnaa yaa Rabbana min al-maqbooleen ladayhim.
As-salaamu `alaykum yaa`ibaadAllah! Thumma 's-salaamu `alayk yaa Saahib al-Waqt, yaa Qutb alMutasarrif maa bayna 'l-mashaariq wa 'l-maghaarib, (supporting) in our lives what is necessary for us to do
and understand and to follow the ways of saaliheen.
Thumma 's-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders from every kind of people, Muslims or non-Muslims, Christians
or Jewish people, Buddhists or Hindus! All of us are coming from Adam and Eve (a) and everyone is coming

to this life knowing nothing! We are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Allah Almighty is
sending us to this dunya for a while on this planet, and our Lord likes to grant us from His endless blessings.
"As-salaamu `alaykum" is from Heavens, and all of us are in front of that salaam coming from Heavens. That
salaam is giving people honor and pleasure here and Hereafter, taking us away from every trouble, miseries,
and sufferings. You must learn; we have been created and ordered to learn. If a person is not learning, their
level is going to be the level of animals, but you are a member of human nature. You are from the holy family
of the first man, Adam (a). And we are saying, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh sits) That gives you honor here and Hereafter, and
it is carrying from you every badness, taking away harm from you!
This planet is full with good and bad things. Good things are for good ones and bad things are for bad ones; it
is so easy. The first teaching from Heavens is coming to Adam (a) as he is the father of all Mankind, and the
first one who bowed to his Lord. What was the first order from Heavens to Adam? It was, "O Adam! Be a
good one. O Adam! Don't be a bad one." That is a Heavenly declaration from Heavens coming to Adam (a)
from the Lord of Heavens. Then coming to Adam khitaab, "O Adam! Try to be a good one, beware to be from
bad ones." That is the first Heavenly order that Adam (a) had been ordered and he had also been ordered, "O
Adam! Declare to your children to be good ones, not to be bad ones." Heavenly addressing, "I like good ones,
I don't like bad ones."
As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders! Keep only these two words and go away, if you are not listening to other
words, keep these too and you will be happy here and Hereafter. Allah Almighty is saying, "O Adam! I like
good ones, I am hating bad ones." All prophets' message is on that point, to be good ones, not to be bad ones.
Good ones are blessed ones, bad ones are cursed ones. Who are good ones? They are ones who are following
Heavenly commands and giving their goodness to everything in Creation. And you must think that Allah
Almighty likes every creature that is in existence to be in existence. If He is not asking (for it to be in
existence), He is never creating. Therefore, you must give for everything that Heavenly order and you must
try to be with everything as a good one. If you are not doing good for everything, you are against that
Heavenly command.
O People! All prophets were coming to teach that point, trying to make Mankind good ones. If the Lord of
Heavens is leaving Mankind, Shaytan is always asking to make people bad ones, harmful ones. Allah

Almighty never likes those people. The followers of Shaytan are never getting any pleasure here or Hereafter.
O our Attenders! Keep your lesson today: who is following Shaytan is never going to be happy here or
Hereafter, but who is following goodness will be accepted, rewarded, honored ones here and Hereafter,
forever! Try to be an honored one, an accepted one, a good one. Christians can't say, Jewish people can't say,
other nations can't say this is wrong. No one can say the Lord of Heavens likes bad ones and no one can say
the Lord of Creation likes bad ones; it can't be, as 124,000 prophets were just coming with a Heavenly
message to be good ones. Why are people running to belong to sects? Why? What are they asking? What is
their aim? What is Christians' aim? What is Jewish peoples' aim? To make all people dead ones? Did their
beliefs and their prophets say to them, "O People! Try to make people dead ones." (No, prophets said) "O
people, be good ones," because our Creator likes good ones and hates bad ones. He prepared eight paradises
for good ones and seven hells for bad ones.
O Salafi `ulamas! Welcome!
•••••••••••• ••••• •••• •••••••• ••••••••
As-salaam `ala man ittiba` al-hudaa.
Peace be upon those who follow the guidance. (20:47)
I must say this for Salafi `ulamas who are following Heavenly direction, that all prophets and their
representatives, awliya, follow. That is also in Christianity, that the main aim is to make people follow good
ones. No prophet was coming to make people fight each other, kill each other, and deal with people in a bad
way, no. Allah Almighty likes good ones. Try to be good ones!
O Salafi `ulamas! What is goodness? Say! You must know the holy hadeeth from the Seal of Prophets (s).
What was he saying? (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
••••••• ••• ••••• •• ••• •••••• ••••• ••••••: •• ••• ••• ••••• •••••••: ••••• ••••• •• ••••••. ••••••• •••• •• •••••••
Al-eemaanu bid`a(aw thalaathata) wa saba`oon shu`batan `aalaaha laa ilaaha ill-Allah wa adnaaha eemaatat
al-adhaa min at-tareeq wa'l-hayyaa min al-eemaan
“Imaan, faith, is composed of 70 and more branches, the highest of which is the shahaadah and the lowest of

which is to remove what is harmful from the way, (and modesty is a branch of faith).” (the two Sahihs)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) I think that they must know this hadith, alhamdulillah. If they are saying it is not a
hadith, they are leaving Islam. That is thalaatha wa saba`een, shu`bah. That is, if you are looking and seeing
that a person said, la ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah, that person entered Islam and the circle of
imaan. Yes? Yes! SubhaanAllah. But who claims "We are Salafi `ulamas," if we are making some wrong
things, they say, "You are mushrik (polytheist); you are kafir (unbeliever); you are ibn haraam, (son of the
forbidden, bastard), you are saahib al-bida` (master of innovation)!" And they are fighting prophets. Look,
you must understand that hadeethi 'sh-shareef that the Seal of Prophets (s) was saying and he was never
saying by himself, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) as Allah Almighty is:
••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• •••••••• •••••••
wa kafaa billahi shaheedan Muhammadun Rasoolullah!
Allah is sufficient as Witness: Muhammad is the Prophet of Allah! (48:28-29)
All speech of the Prophet (s) is revelation!
••••• ••••••• •••• •••••••• •••• •••• •••••• •••••• ••••••
Wa maa yantiqu `ani ’l-hawaa in huwa illa wahiyyun yooha
That (which he conveys to you) is but (a divine) inspiration with which he is inspired. (53:3-4)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar! They are putting so many soldiers in Haramayn
Sharifayn (the Two Holy Sanctuaries) and accusing hujjaaj (pilgrims) as mushrik! They can't do this! It is
another holy hadeeth of Prophet (s) also:
•• ••• •••• ••• •••
Man kafara mu`minan faqad kafar.
Who says to a believer he is an unbeliever then the one saying it becomes kafir.
You can't accuse a Muslim of being an unbeliever, or the one who accuses is an unbeliever! (Mawlana Shaykh
stands) Who says, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah, is a mu`min, believer! (Mawlana Shaykh
sits) They are filling Haramayn Sharifayn with people who accuse, "You are not Muslims, you are mushrik,
you are saahib al-bida`, you are doing haraam." Who gives them that authority, their kings? If so, those kings

must fear Allah Almighty, Who is making them to sit on that chair! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Anyone who
says, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah, is a mu`min, the highest level for Islam. And the most
simple sign of imaan is imaatat ul-azza. If you are looking at a person removing a nail from the path, you may
say, "That is a mu`min." If you see person taking a melon's skin, you can't say, "This is not a Muslim or
mu`min." And there are so many branches, up to 73! Mostly those who claim they are Salafi `ulamas are not
looking at that hadeethi 'sh-sharif. You must look and write on that hadeethi 'sh-shareef, one, two, three or
more volumes on the meaning of Islam, examples that the Seal of Prophets (s) gave. Where is that book? Do
it, and send it to me also; I am asking to learn, but you are not asking to learn!
You are only accusing people of haraam, shikr, kufr and bida`, but you are wrong ones! Allah Almighty never
likes wrong ones, He likes true ones. Who is teaching you? And Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh
stands)
••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••••• •••• •••••••••••
Yaa ayyuha 'Lladheena `aamanoo ittaqoollah wa koonoo ma` as-saadiqeen.
O you who believe! Fear Allah and be with those who are true (in word and deed). (9:119)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) Who are saadiq, write their names and don't say they are laying in graveyards now!
Allah Almighty said, Y Was that holy order only for Sahaabah (r) or for the whole nation? Who is your saadiq,
your holy one? His knowledge is Heavenly knowledge and they may show you the true way, so who is that
one? Say one name from them, Salafi `ulamas. I am not asking who is lying in a cemetery. Don't think all
saadiqeen passed away and in our times there are no saadiqeen. What is the meaning of the Holy Qur'an,
what is the meaning of ordering, koonoo ma` as-saadiqeen? You say they passed away, and if anyone is
visiting their tombs you say that is shirk! But you can't show us in this life one saadiq person. Show us and we
may follow. Deen al-Islam is not a toy, no!
O Salafi `ulamas and Wahabi tails, you must come to be mu'addab, good mannered and mu`mins. What is
Allah Almighty saying? All Wahabi people, who are you following now, say his name! Allah (swt) is saying,
koonoo ma` as-saadiqeen. In our time are there no saadiqeen? Why is Allah Almighty sending that holy
verse? Wrong way! Bring me a saadiq and I may go to see him. But you are lying and escaping from truth,
from essence. Say! Bring one from saadiqeen and say to him to make an explanation or commentary on that

hadith and send to me that book. You can't do this! And if you can't do it, you are on the wrong way. Allah
Almighty will punish you here and Hereafter. That's why mostly Salafi people have no lights, no noor on their
faces! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Islam is so clear. Nothing in it is not to be understood! You can understand everything but you
must ask, as Allah Almighty is saying: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••••••••• ••• •• •••••••
fas'al bihi khabeera.
Ask the expert (who knows). (25:59)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) You are not going to ask anybody, no. Ask from experts and write your books. So
many books you just burned and it is not for you to burn books! If you are not putting another book,
correcting that book, it is haraam for you to burn it or destroy it! And now the whole world must know,
Muslims, wrong Muslims, Christians, wrong Christians, Jewish people, wrong Jewish people, Hindus, wrong
Hindu people, all of them must come to say what is the Truth! Truth is only one, but lies are countless. Fear
from Allah (swt)!
inna batsha rabbuka la shadeed.
Your Lord's punishment is severe. (Al-Buruj, 85:12)
If Allah Almighty is sending His Heavenly cursing, when Heavenly anger comes no one can stop it! May Allah
forgive us for the honor of the most honored one, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa
sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(42 minutes)
Alhamdulillah. Today is Sunday. Our attenders are going to make themselves happy, to reach pleasure, but

they can't do, they can't do! If not taking that care (to see this broadcast) everyday they are making a weak
servant to address to people, they are never tasting anything of this life's pleasure or the Next Life's pleasures.
That is a warning!
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaats Salaat ash-Shukr.)
Fatihah.
Tonight is the first night of Shabaan Mu`azzam; if other calendars are not writing this, it is wrong. Mubarak
to all beleivers, to all Muslims, who are asking for the pleasure of the Seal of Prophets (s). Alhamdulillah.

SubhaanAllahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem.
11.07.2010
